# InAccessmod.qmd Documentation

## Overview
The `InAccessmod.qmd` file contains the data preparation code for the Accessmod tool. This tool is used for analyzing physical accessibility in the context of undernutrition in Uganda.

## Purpose
The purpose of this file is to preprocess the input data required by the Accessmod tool. It performs various data cleaning, transformation, and aggregation tasks to ensure that the data is in the appropriate format for analysis.

## Usage
To use this file, follow these steps:
1. Ensure that the required input data files are available.
2. Open the `InAccessmod.qmd` file in a compatible code editor or environment.
3. Review the code and make any necessary modifications based on your specific data requirements.
4. Execute the code to preprocess the data.

## Dependencies
This file has dependencies on the `inAccessMod` package. Make sure to install the package using the `devtools::install_github` function before running the code.

## Output
The output of this file is the preprocessed data that can be used as input for the Accessmod tool. The specific format and structure of the output data will depend on the requirements of the tool.

## Notes
- It is recommended to review the code and documentation of the Accessmod tool to understand the expected input data format and any additional preprocessing steps that may be required.

## References
- [Accessmod Tool Documentation](https://www.accessmod.org/)

# Install the inAccessMod package from GitHub & load the library
```{r}
# Set up renv for package management
if (!requireNamespace("renv", quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages("renv")
} else {
    message("renv is already installed.")
}

# Load the renv package
library(renv)

# Check if renv is already active, activate if not
if (!renv::status()$synchronized) {
    renv::activate()
}

# To restore the environment (for a collaborator)
renv::restore()

# Load the required libraries
library(inAccessMod)
library(terra)
```

# Initialize the project for Uganda
```{r}
# Set the main path for the project
# This path will be used as the root directory for all input and output files related to the Accessmod tool
mainPath <- "D:/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/InAccessmod"


# Set the country name
# This variable will be used to specify the country for which the analysis is being performed
country <- "Uganda"
```

# Download or process the required input data for AccessMod
## Administrative boundaries
```{r}
# Parish boundaries
inputPath_adm <- "D:/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/Data/Processed/Adm_boundaries_parishes"
copy_input(mainPath, country, inputPath_adm)
```

## Population data
```{r}
# Total population/women of reproductive age (WRA) population/under 5 population
inputPath_pop <- "D:/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/Data/RAW/WorldPop_density/Inaccessmod"
copy_input(mainPath, country, inputPath_pop)
```

## Digital Elevation Model (DEM)
```{r}
inputPath_DEM <- "D:/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/Data/RAW/DEM/Uganda_SRTM30m"
copy_input(mainPath, country, inputPath_DEM)
```

## Land cover data
```{r}
inputPath_LC <- "D:/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/Data/RAW/Landcover/terrascope_download_20240305_144418/ESA_WorldCover_10m_2021_v200_N00E030_Map"
copy_input(mainPath, country, inputPath_LC)
```

## Health facilities data
```{r}
# Health facilities all/ hospitals only
inputPath_HF <- "D:/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/Data/RAW/Facilities/suhsharan_health_facilities_UG"
copy_input(mainPath, country, inputPath_HF)
```

## OpenStreetMap (OSM) data
```{r}
# Roads data
download_osm(x = "roads", mainPath, country, alwaysDownload = TRUE, countryName = TRUE, mostRecent = NULL, defaultClasses = TRUE)
```

# Flood data
```{r}
inputPath_flood <- "D:/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/Data/RAW/Flood_extents_Kampala/Flood_extents_full"
copy_input(mainPath, country, inputPath_flood)
```

# Set the projected coordinate reference system
```{r}
set_projection(mainPath, country, mostRecent = TRUE, alwaysSet = TRUE, bestCRS = TRUE)
```

# Process the input data for AccessMod This cannot be done for rasters using the `process_inputs` function as we need to do a manual disaggregation correction for the population data (see 02.pop_raster_correction.qmd.). 
```{r}
# Use this function to process the vector data (e.g. administrative boundaries, health facilities, OSM roads). No need to use this function for rasters as they are processed in the next step (therefore no extra settings are provided for rasters in this function).
process_inputs(mainPath, country, mostRecent = TRUE, alwaysProcess = FALSE)

# Process the population data
## see 02. pop_raster_correction.qmd for the population data processing

# pre-process the raster data to be smaller
dem <- rast("D:/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/InAccessmod/Uganda/data/rDEM/20240308161123/raw/Uganda_SRTM30meters.tif")
landcover <- rast("D:/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/InAccessmod/Uganda/data/rLandcover/20240308161141/raw/ESA_WorldCover_10m_2021_v200_N00E030_Map.tif")

## Crop to the study area
study_area <- vect("D:/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/InAccessmod/Uganda/data/vBorders/20240308161055/processed/20240308162043/vBorders_Processed.shp")

study_area <- project(study_area, crs(dem))
study_area <- buffer(study_area, 1000) # buffer by 1km to ensure we have enough data for the analysis

dem <- crop(dem, study_area)
landcover <- crop(landcover, study_area)

## save the cropped rasters
writeRaster(dem, "D:/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/InAccessmod/Uganda/data/rDEM/20240308161123/processed/DEM_cropped.tif", overwrite = TRUE)
writeRaster(landcover, "D:/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/InAccessmod/Uganda/data/rLandcover/20240308161141/processed/ESA_WorldCover_10m_2021_v200_N00E030_Map_cropped.tif", overwrite = TRUE)

# Move to QGIS
## Use the align raster tool to align all rasters to the same crs and resolution as the population data

# In QGIS clip the road data to the study area as this is not done by the process_inputs function

# All these files are then saved from QGIS to the processed folder and can be used for the next steps and for AccessMod

# Load the aligned rasters
dem <- rast("D:/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/InAccessmod/Uganda/data/rDEM/20240308161123/processed/DEM_10m.tif")
landcover <- rast("D:/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/InAccessmod/Uganda/data/rLandcover/20240308161141/processed/Landcover_10m.tif")

# mask the rasters data to the study area
study_area <- vect("D:/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/InAccessmod/Uganda/data/vBorders/20240308161055/processed/20240308162043/vBorders_Processed.shp") # load the study area again to ensure the correct crs

dem <- mask(dem, study_area)
landcover <- mask(landcover, study_area)
```

# Label land cover classes for AccessMod
```{r}
label_landcover(mainPath, country, mostRecent = TRUE, overwrite = F, defaultLabels = FALSE)

# See WorldCover website for the land cover classes
```

# Compile all processed data for easier import into AccessMod
```{r}
# For vector data use the compile_processed_data function
compile_processed_data(mainPath, country, mostRecent = FALSE)

# For raster data save manually in ZtoAccessMod folder
writeRaster(dem, "D:/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/InAccessmod/Uganda/data/zToAccessMod/20240319094916/DEM_10m.tif", overwrite = TRUE)
writeRaster(landcover, "D:/Onedrive/PhD_Undernutrition_Uganda_Physical_Accessbility/2_Study_2_Flooding_Analysis/InAccessmod/Uganda/data/zToAccessMod/20240319094916/landcover_10m.tif", overwrite = TRUE)
```
